QuestInfo.name: Power of the Spirit of Light
QuestInfo.0: Before leaving Ereve, go see Chief Knight Mihile and raise the Skill Level of Mihile's Soul Driver.
QuestInfo.1: To use Mihile's Soul Driver, you need a catalyst that will maximize the power of the Spirit of Light. Get it from #r#o6130200##k or #r#o6130207##k.
QuestInfo.2: You have mastered Mihile's Soul Driver.

0.0: Long time no see, #b#h0##k. Did you come here to raise the Skill Level of Soul Driver?

yes.0: I will gladly raise the Skill Level for you. As you know, the skill condenses the power of the Spirit of Light, and forms it into a sword.
yes.1: Soul Light is needed for such powerful force. If you can bring #b10 #t4032867#s#k from #r#o6130200##k or #r#o6130207##k monsters, I'll show you the power of the Ultimate Explorer.

1.0: Oh, I can feel the power. That's more than enough Soul Light to raise the Skill Level.

yes.0: You have finally mastered Soul Driver.

item.0: Without Soul Light, you cannot harness the Spirit of Light. You must bring #b10 #t4032867#s#k from #r#o6130200##k or #r#o6130207##k monsters.
